evidence.quote: the e2e suite asserts that saving a memory enrolls its creator as a reviewer

observations.why: The suite is granted authority to assign a role (reviewer) to the creator — a rank-based allocation enacted by an automated arbiter.

evidence.quote: This probe memory exists only to carry that assertion

observations.why: The memory is framed as a vehicle for the enrollment rule, reinforcing the suite's authority to assign reviewer status by submitting to that purpose.

mints.name: AutomatedRoleEnrollment
mints.title: a system enrolls a person into a role as a consequence of an action they performed
mints.frame: Does the expression enact or invoke an automated authority that assigns a social role to a person based on their action?
